name: Onirio
source:
You move to San Onirio, a quiet town... too quiet, where nothing seems out of place.

New school, new routines, new faces... and the opportunity to start anew.

Clubs, conversations, romances, and small decisions will shape your day to day life... while something, almost imperceptible, makes its way into the everyday.

This might seem like a school romance story, with a touch of magic and mystery.

Welcome to San Onirio.

Are you ready to discover what lurks in its corners?

[Translated from [url=https://estudios-onirio.itch.io/onirio]Itch.io[/url]]
